scope: Focused local draft retention/privacy audit; no runtime, provider, status, PDF or publication changes

retentionInterpretation.logs: Daily segments; closed file expiry seven days after last write; an early entry can be about eight days old plus scheduled cleanup interval. Derived from hash-matched installed source, not eight days of observed data.
retentionInterpretation.snapshots: Thirty-day age pruning on scheduled collector; no instantaneous per-record erasure guarantee.
retentionInterpretation.backups: Seven-day age/count pruning on scheduled collector/backup; earlier account data remains until scheduled removal.
retentionInterpretation.legacyLogs: Two restricted historical logs outside managed expiry. Owner must choose retirement or justified bounded treatment; no assumed removal or indefinite period.

remainingPolicyBehaviorWitness: Real isolated consumer erasure with provider absence, canonical tombstone/status, preserved protected-account data and restart reconciliation; no existing receipt proves this
